apps.name: Earth Atlas: Picture Games
apps.tagline: Play the planet: country maps, flags, animals, rivers and mountains. Offline.
apps.featureAlt: Earth Atlas: Picture Games: a night-blue globe with country shapes, a flag, an animal and a mountain
about: Earth Atlas: Picture Games is a set of geography games on real maps. See a country on its map and flag, a river's path or a mountain's country, then tap the city, animal, river, mountain, climate or neighbour that belongs to it.

Every play draws fresh countries and animals from the whole world, or you can pick a continent. Wrong cards grey out so you can try again. Text size runs from 100% to 300%, and there are colour themes and a reduce-motion setting.
It plays fully offline once installed: no account, no sign-in, no ads and no tracking. Every game lists the sources of its facts, such as Natural Earth and United Nations statistics.
apps.pricing: Capital Cities is free to play. Each of the other ten games is a one-time purchase, with no subscription. Every other game has a free 90-second preview, in the browser demo here and in app version 1.0.1.
